meta.name: browse
meta.description:
Fast headless browser for QA testing and site dogfooding. Navigate any URL, interact with
elements, verify page state, diff before/after actions, take annotated screenshots, check
responsive layouts, test forms and uploads, handle dialogs, and assert element states.
~100ms per command. Use when you need to test a feature, verify a deployment, dogfood a
user flow, or file a bug with evidence.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动测试网页功能、验证部署效果并截图留证。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动检查网页功能、验证发布后是否正常、给 bug 提供证据。
copy.tagline_en: Test web pages, verify deployments, and capture screenshots for bugs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser checks and give evidence when filing bugs.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能操作无头浏览器:打开网址、点击、填表、上传文件、处理弹窗;还能检查页面内容、截图、对比操作前后变化,用来做测试或找 bug。浏览器状态(如登录)在多次操作间保留。
howto.when: 当用户需要 QA 测试(测试功能、验证部署、试用用户流程)或带着证据报 bug 时触发。

say.text: 帮我用浏览器测试一下 example.com:页面能正常加载吗?有报错吗?
say.note: 会返回页面文本和控制台错误。

say.text: 帮我测试登录流程:打开登录页,填账号密码,点登录,看是否成功。
say.note: 会自动操作并对比操作前后快照。

say.text: 给当前页面截一张带标注的截图,标出所有可点击元素。
say.note: 生成带红色标注框的截图。

howto.what_en: Claude can drive a headless browser to open URLs, click, fill forms, upload files, handle dialogs, verify pages, take annotated screenshots, and diff before/after actions. Browser state persists between calls.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs QA testing (testing a feature, verifying a deployment, dogfooding a flow) or filing a bug with evidence.

say_en.text: Open example.com with the browser and check it loads without errors.
say_en.note: Returns page text and console errors.

say_en.text: Test login: open the login page, fill in credentials, submit, confirm.
say_en.note: Automates actions and diffs before/after snapshots.

say_en.text: Take an annotated screenshot of this page highlighting clickable elements.
